sentences.translation: FUJIWARA no Ren is eighteen years old when he just entered university.
You must open a bank account to receive a part-time job.
I put my student card, my number card, and seal in my bag.
I was not confident that I needed a seal, but I was glad to bring it.
When I got to the bank, I got my number.
I waited for twenty-five minutes in the waiting room and the window called me by name.
When I handed the documents to the woman in charge, I was taught how to write the application.
There were some kanji that I didn't know, and I filled it out while checking how to read.
What is the purpose of using the account?"
Ren answered, "I'm going to get a part-time job."
The person in charge nodded and entered it on the computer.
After the procedure was completed, I received my passbook and cash card.
I could set my PIN to use the card.
When he left the bank, he felt a little grown up.
